title: Propylene Glycol based Heat-Transfer Fluids
description: Calculate properties of propylene glycol based heat-transfer fluids suitable for the food processing industry, including freezing points, specific gravities, densities, boiling points, and specific heats.

components.content:
## Propylene Glycol based Heat-Transfer Fluids

Propylene glycol based heat-transfer fluids are commonly used in food processing systems where lower freezing points and safety are required. This calculator helps you determine the properties of propylene glycol and water solutions at different concentrations.

**Important:** Due to slush creation, a propylene glycol and water solution should not be used close to freezing points.

outputs.label: Freezing Point
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 5, 0, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 15, -3, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 25, -8, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 35, -14, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 45, -22, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 55, -34, -48))))))

outputs.label: Specific Gravity (at 60°F / 15.6°C)
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 5, 1.000, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 15, 1.008, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 25, 1.017, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 35, 1.026, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 45, 1.034, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 55, 1.041, 1.046))))))

outputs.label: Boiling Point
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 5, 212, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 15, 212, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 25, 213, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 35, 216, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 45, 219, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 55, 222, 225))))))

outputs.label: Specific Heat
outputs.formula: IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 5, 1.000, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 15, 0.980, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 25, 0.960, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 35, 0.935, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 45, 0.895, IF(inputs.pg_concentration_mass < 55, 0.850, 0.805))))))
